name: cpu-model
rationale: The first accepted AE lattice-energy pair yields -124.637 kJ/mol, 10.912 kJ/mol stronger binding than GAPW_XC-GTH. Its crystal used the GPU model and its molecule the CPU model. The earlier CO2 pseudopotential CPU/GPU agreement does not establish the AE case. Isolate model-device sensitivity on the same Terok binary, 24 threads and CPUs60-83 from the exact accepted final k-point WFN. Retain geometry, AE basis, grids, D3, full 3x3x3 symmetry reduction with the original tolerance, IRAC/FULL_ALL/DIIS and EPS_SCF5e-7. This is a separate numerical control, not a new base case or repeated acceptance run.
comparison: (E_crystal_CPU - E_crystal_GPU) / 2 * 2625.4996394799 kJ/mol. The molecular CPU result is unchanged, so this is also the lattice-energy shift for switching the crystal model device. It does not bound basis, BSSE, k-point or quadrature errors; compare magnitude with the provisional 0.5 kJ/mol numerical target.
